packageRules.description: jsdom 30.1 moved the Blob internals that Vitest's URL.createObjectURL patch reads into a private field, which breaks every upload test on Vitest 4 and 5 alike. Drop this rule once vitest-dev/vitest#11336 is fixed (WEB-318).

Every dependency lives in the pnpm catalog, whose entries are neither `dependencies` nor `devDependencies`. The `bump` strategy of mheob/renovate-config does not reach them, so Renovate would only refresh the lockfile; keep raising the ranges as before.

vite-plus bundles Vitest, and `vp migrate` re-pins `vitest` and its lockstep packages to the bundled runner. Bumped on their own they would split Vitest between two copies (https://viteplus.dev/guide/upgrade-project#updating-the-vitest-pin).
vite-plus and the `vite` alias to its core ship together. Their own PR, because it needs `vp migrate` before merging.
prBodyNotes: Run `vp migrate` on this branch and commit the result, so `vitest` and `@vitest/coverage-v8` follow the runner the new release bundles.
